units:
Scatter Plot (Relationship Between Variables)
It shows
Relationship between two variables 
Pattern: linear / non-linear 
Importance
Detect correlation (like in your PCA example) 
Identify clusters and outliers

Line Plot (Trend Over Time)
It shows
Trends over time 
Importance
Used in forecasting
Helps detect growth/decline patterns

Bar Chart (Comparison Between Categories)
It shows
Comparison across categories 
Importance
Easy to compare values 
Widely used in reports

Histogram (Distribution of Data)
It shows
Frequency distribution 
Shape of data (normal, skewed) 
Importance
Understand data spread
Important before applying PCA/ML

Box Plot (Outliers & Spread)
It shows
Median, quartiles 
Outliers (100 here) 
Importance
Detect extreme values
Helps in data cleaning

Pair Plot (Used in PCA Context)
It shows
Pairwise relationships 
Importance
Detect multicollinearity
Helps decide if PCA is needed
